title: Recruiter Screen Output
description: The structured shape the ENRICH stage produces from screen notes plus candidate context. The FORMAT stage renders this into a doc, email, doc tab, or ATS note. Edit this to change what the screen writeup contains; keep it in sync with config/screen-doc.template.md.

role.description: Role the candidate was screened for

summary.description: 2-3 sentence read a hiring manager can skim

standard_answers.description: One entry per cemented standard question, answered from the notes and context. Order and ids follow config/standard-questions.json.

answer.description: The answer inferred from the notes; say 'not covered' if the notes do not address it

evidence.description: Short quote or paraphrase from the notes that supports the answer

recommendation.description: Overall read; the qualitative tier is the source of truth, score is the sort key

follow_up_questions.description: Open questions the next interviewer should resolve
